moments.title: The Boss Turns 77
moments.blurb: Legendary rock and roll icon Bruce Springsteen celebrates his 77th birthday today, still touring and captivating audiences worldwide.

angles.name: Still the Boss
angles.copy: 77 years young today! Bruce Springsteen, still roaring on stage and proving why he's The Boss. What's your ultimate Springsteen anthem?

angles.name: Born to Run Forever
angles.copy: Happy 77th to Bruce Springsteen! From 'Born to Run' to stadium singalongs, his energy is unmatched. Which track defines him for you?

moments.title: John Coltrane at 100
moments.blurb: Today marks what would have been the 100th birthday of pioneering jazz saxophonist and composer John Coltrane, a truly influential figure in music history.

angles.name: A Century of Coltrane
angles.copy: Remembering John Coltrane on what would have been his 100th birthday. His groundbreaking jazz continues to inspire generations. What's your favourite Coltrane piece?

angles.name: Jazz Icon's Legacy
angles.copy: 100 years since John Coltrane's birth. His saxophone changed music forever. Take a moment to appreciate the genius of a true legend.

moments.title: Ani DiFranco's 55th

angles.name: Righteous Babe at 55
angles.copy: Happy 55th Birthday to the incredible Ani DiFranco! A true independent spirit in music. What's your go-to track from her extensive catalogue?

moments.title: Jermaine Dupri's 54th

angles.name: JD at 54
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to Jermaine Dupri! A hitmaker responsible for so many bangers. What's your favourite JD-produced track?
